# Native dex2jar acceptance corpus

These files are repository-authored DEX 035 fixtures generated by
`go run ./dex2jar/testdata/generate_accept`. The generator directly writes
DEX structures and uses only the Go standard library; no Android SDK, D8, network,
or external compiler is involved.

- `arithmetic.dex` defines `accept.Arithmetic`. It has a real constructor,
  an instance integer field, static integer arithmetic and branching, object creation,
  virtual/static invokes, and a self-checking `main` method.
- `multidex.apk` contains canonical `classes.dex` and `classes2.dex` entries
  defining the unique classes `accept.apk.Primary` and `accept.apk.Secondary`. Its
  asset and resource placeholders are intentionally not DEX inputs.

All class annotation offsets and code debug-info offsets are zero. The DEX headers
contain standard SHA-1 signatures and Adler-32 checksums. `SHA256SUMS` pins the
checked-in binary corpus.
